description: Holding the 19th World Trade Union Congress in Sri Lanka from 2027-05-13 to 2027-05-15
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been decided to hold the 19th World Trade Union Congress, organized by the World Federation of Trade Unions, in Colombo from 2027-05-13 to 2027-05-15. Considering Sri Lanka’s active trade union sector and strategic location, the Presidential Council of the World Federation of Trade Unions has entrusted the hosting of the said Congress to Sri Lanka. It is expected that approximately 800 delegates from nearly 130 countries, representing trade unions across the globe, will participate in the event. Accordingly, the Minister of Labour informed the Cabinet regarding the hosting of the 19th World Trade Union Congress in Colombo from 2027-05-13 to 2027-05-15 by Sri Lanka and the Cabinet granted its concurrence to proceed with the necessary arrangements.
